```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

root=Path.cwd()
while not (root/'.unaltraweb/computations.yml').exists():
    if root==root.parent:raise RuntimeError('No es troba el projecte')
    root=root.parent
out=root/'assets/img/generated/semivariograma.svg'
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
plt.rcParams.update({'font.family':'DejaVu Sans','font.size':14,'svg.fonttype':'none',
                     'axes.spines.top':False,'axes.spines.right':False})
residuals=np.array([1,.5,-.5,-1,0])
empirical=[np.mean((residuals[:-lag]-residuals[lag:])**2)/2 for lag in range(1,5)]
assert np.allclose(empirical,[.3125,4.75/6,1.0625,.5])
h=np.linspace(.0001,6,400);ratio=np.minimum(h/4,1)
gamma=.2+1.8*(1.5*ratio-.5*ratio**3)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7.4,4.3),layout='constrained')
ax.plot(h,gamma,color='#003366',lw=3)
ax.plot([0,0],[0,.2],color='#990000',ls=':',lw=2)
ax.scatter([0],[0],color='#003366',s=35,zorder=4)
ax.scatter([0],[.2],facecolors='white',edgecolors='#003366',s=40,zorder=4)
ax.axhline(2,color='#666666',ls='--',lw=1)
ax.vlines(4,0,2,color='#39734d',ls='--',lw=1.5)
ax.annotate('Llindar total: 2 °C²',(5.1,2),xytext=(3.45,2.38),fontsize=14,
            arrowprops={'arrowstyle':'->','color':'#666666'})
ax.annotate('Llavor: 0,2 °C²',(0,.2),xytext=(.55,.43),color='#990000',fontsize=14,
            arrowprops={'arrowstyle':'->','color':'#990000'})
ax.text(4,.13,'Abast: 4 km',ha='left',color='#39734d',fontsize=14)
ax.set(xlim=(-.1,6),ylim=(-.05,2.6),xlabel='Separació entre localitzacions (km)',
       ylabel='Semivariància (°C²)',xticks=range(7))
fig.savefig(out,facecolor='white',metadata={'Date':None})
plt.close(fig)
```
